kyoto_il_lago_bacaro.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: pastas (penne with Gorgonzola cream, Genovese with shrimp), fried blue crab and maitake fritters (2026 reviews).
kyoto_il_lago_bacaro.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cicchetti, prosciutto, pâté, cheese and seafood pastas (2026 reviews). Some vegetable plates (marinated purple cabbage, eggplant with balsamic), but no vegan menu is mentioned.
kyoto_il_lago_bacaro.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Wed 15:00–24:00 (food L.O. 22:00, drinks 23:30); Fri–Sun 15:00–1:00 (food L.O. 23:00, drinks 0:30); 15:00–17:00 drinks and light snacks, then dinner and bar; light snacks only after 22:00. Closed Thursday and other irregular days — check the shop's Instagram. Reservations taken; dessert plates by phone; courses by the day before. Standing at the counter is free; tables carry a ¥400 seat charge at dinner — Tabelog, Japanese original 「スタンディングはチャージなし、テーブルはお席代400円」. 36 places: 20 standing, 16 at high tables. Non-smoking. Cards, e-money and QR. English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog). Children welcome.
kyoto_il_lago_bacaro.notes: [Italian standing bar · Kawaramachi-Sanjo, a Venetian bacaro] A Venice-style bacaro near City Hall: stand at the front counter for cicchetti and a glass of wine from about ¥1,800, or take a high table for pasta, fritters and courses. Open from 3 pm to midnight or 1 am; English menu. ¥400 table charge, standing free. Closed Thursday.

roles: Operator: 株式会社HOTTA (NTA invoice registration at the shop address)
chef_bio.background: Opened 3 November 2017 (Tabelog). 2026 reviewers describe a lively place, popular with diners in their 20s, used for girls' nights and birthdays, with attentive staff and an extensive wine list; weekday tables were nearly fully booked in August 2026 while the standing counter was quiet.
chef_bio.philosophy: Modeled on the bacari of Venice (September 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Cicchetti; pastas; Italian wine by the glass.

anecdotes.text: September 2026: "I had researched beforehand and found this Italian place inspired by the bacari of Venice, which opens at 3:00 PM… Leaning against the counter while chatting casually with the staff and sipping beer was fantastic."
April 2026: "The marinated purple cabbage was especially delicious, so I ordered it twice. The wine selection was also extensive."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: IL LAGO、イタリアン・立ち飲み・ワインバー、中京区河原町三条二筋上ル恵比須町534-29、地下鉄京都市役所前駅から徒歩2分、月〜水15:00〜24:00 (料理L.O.22:00、ドリンクL.O.23:30)、金〜日15:00〜翌1:00 (料理L.O.23:00、ドリンクL.O.0:30)、15:00〜17:00はドリンクと軽食、22時以降は軽食のみ、木曜と不定休 (Instagramで告知)、予約可、デザートプレートは電話で、原文で「スタンディングはチャージなし、テーブルはお席代400円」、36席 (立ち20・テーブル16)、禁煙 (外に灰皿)、カード・電子マネー・QR可、英語メニュー・英語対応スタッフ、子連れ可、2017年11月3日オープン。インボイス登録は株式会社HOTTA (店の住所、国税庁)。口コミ (2026年4月〜10月、英語): ヴェネツィアのバーカロ風の立ち飲みイタリアン、チケッティ盛り合わせ1,000円、グラスの赤ワイン800円、エビのジェノベーゼ、紫キャベツのマリネ、ペンネのゴルゴンゾーラクリーム、舞茸のフリット、生ハム、フルーツのカプレーゼ、ハウスワインはプリミティーヴォ、誕生日プレート、コース。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog). Standing counter is free; ¥400 per person at tables.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated August, September and October 2026.

kyoto_wagyu_ichinone.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: sukiyaki simmered in a sweet secret sauce (warishita) that reviewers say comes from a long-established Japanese restaurant in Fukui (April–May 2026 reviews); soy-based sauces normally contain wheat.
kyoto_wagyu_ichinone.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an A5 Wagyu sukiyaki shop; egg yolk and cheese in the finishing rice (2026 reviews).
kyoto_wagyu_ichinone.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon and Wed–Sun and holidays 12:00–21:00; closed Tuesday. Reservations taken. 12 seats: 8 at the counter and private rooms for 2 and 4 (sunken kotatsu seating per a 2026 review); private hire up to 20. Non-smoking. Cards (incl. UnionPay), e-money and QR (incl. Alipay, WeChat Pay). Basement of the 祇園ファーストビル on the Shijo-dori approach to Yasaka Shrine, about a minute from the shrine. Opened 1 May 2026.
kyoto_wagyu_ichinone.notes: [Wagyu sukiyaki · Gion by Yasaka Shrine, a basement counter] A new (May 2026) basement counter a minute from Yasaka Shrine serving one-person A5 Wagyu sukiyaki bubbling in a hot stone pot — about ¥4,700–5,300 for 120g — finished with cheesy stone-grilled rice. Open from noon. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 May 2026 (Tabelog). The listing says each cut of Wagyu is chosen by a master connoisseur; a May 2026 reviewer calls the sauce a company secret, and an April 2026 reviewer says it comes from a long-established Japanese restaurant in Fukui. Reviewers describe the staff cooking the sukiyaki for the diner. Operator not identified; one April 2026 review was written at a pre-opening tasting.
chef_bio.specialty: Stone-pot A5 Wagyu sukiyaki; cheese stone-grilled rice.

anecdotes.text: April 2026: "The dipping sauce deserves special mention. Sourced from a long-established Japanese restaurant in Fukui, its balance of sweetness and richness elevates the meat's flavor."
May 2026: "You don't have to worry about cooking it yourself; it's delicious right from the start… The secret sauce is a company secret."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 和牛一乃音 WAGYU ICHINONE、すき焼き・牛料理、東山区祇園町北側281-1-1 祇園ファーストビル B1F、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、月・水〜日・祝 12:00〜21:00、火曜休み、予約可、12席 (カウンター8席、2名・4名の個室)、貸切20名まで、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR可、2026年5月1日オープン、目利きが選ぶ和牛を石焼で。口コミ (2026年4月〜6月、英語、うち1件はプレオープン): 一人用の石焼すき焼き、A5ミスジまたはA5ロースを60g・120g・180gで、A5ミスジ120g 4,700円、A5ロース120g 5,300円、割り下は福井の老舗日本料理店のものとの記載、七味と山椒、締めはチーズの石焼ごはん (卵黄入り)、八坂神社から徒歩1分。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter and small private rooms; staff cook the sukiyaki for you.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (opened 1 May 2026) with reviews dated May and June 2026.

kyoto_saidokoro_yasukawa.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a Kyoto oden shop whose menu runs to croquettes, ham and tenderloin cutlets, fried oysters, shrimp fry and fried sardines; oden includes chikuwa and other fish cakes (2023–2026 reviews). Ask about plain oden items such as daikon and egg — the broth was not described.
kyoto_saidokoro_yasukawa.vegan_detail: Not vegan: oden in dashi with egg and beef tendon, sashimi, cutlets (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_saidokoro_yasukawa.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat 18:00–23:30; closed Sunday; hours and closed days may change, so check before visiting. Reservations taken — a November 2024 reviewer says they are a must. No credit cards (Tabelog). 14 seats: 6 at the counter, 8 at tables. Non-smoking. In the ザ・マインビル, down the first alley north off Sueyoshi-cho east of Hanamikoji (November 2024 review). The shop moved here before December 2023.
kyoto_saidokoro_yasukawa.notes: [Oden & obanzai · Gion north of Shijo, an alley counter] A cheerful 14-seat oden counter tucked down a Gion alley: light Kyoto oden at about ¥300 a piece, obanzai, cutlets and an oden-broth potato salad, or a ¥4,000 omakase course. Reasonable for Gion. Book ahead; no cards. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers since January 2023 describe a homey oden and obanzai shop that relocated within Gion before December 2023, with a cheerful owner who sees guests off and prices well below the Gion norm. Criticism: two reviewers found the oden broth too light or not fully soaked into every item (February and November 2024).
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto-style oden; oden potato salad; fried small potatoes.

anecdotes.text: April 2025: "Oh, and I also ordered the oden potato salad as an extra! It was like egg salad but with the flavor of oden broth—simply exquisite! This is a must-order!"
December 2023: "This was my first visit since they relocated, and the oden was just as good as ever, cooked in a wonderfully flavorful broth."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 菜処 やすかわ、おでん・日本料理、東山区祇園町北側347-133 ザ・マインビル 1F、月〜土18:00〜23:30、日曜休み、営業時間・定休日は変更の可能性あり、予約可、カード不可、14席 (カウンター6・テーブル8)、禁煙。口コミ (2023年1月〜2026年4月、英語): 移転後も変わらぬ京風のおでん (2023年12月)、大根・卵・こんにゃく・しらたき・ちくわ・がんも・牛すじ、1品300円で牛すじは少し高め (2026年4月)、おまかせコース4,000円 (おばんざい、刺身、おでん5品、揚げ物3品、ごはん1品、2025年4月)、おでんのポテトサラダ、だし巻き、小芋の揚げ物、コロッケ、ハムカツ、ヒレカツ、カキフライ、その場で握るおにぎり、まぐろのたたき、明るい店主、予約必須との声 (2024年11月)、だしが薄いとの声 (2024年2月・11月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter shop; book ahead; no cards.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated January and April 2026.

kyoto_kawashige_sanjo.gf_detail: Ask. Dashi-based Kyoto kappo with fried fu and soy-seasoned dishes (2011–2025 reviews).
kyoto_kawashige_sanjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi throughout, sashimi, hamo, squid (2011–2025 reviews).
kyoto_kawashige_sanjo.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 11:30–13:30 and 17:30–21:00; closed Mondays (Tabelog). No cover charge (Tabelog Japanese original 「チャージ料無し。」). Bento to order, with delivery (Tabelog); a 2024 regular says bento must be ordered ahead. 15 seats; a private room for 4 (Tabelog). Down a narrow alley off Kawaramachi south of Sanjo, 3 min from Sanjo (Tabelog; 2011 and July 2025 reviews).
kyoto_kawashige_sanjo.notes: [Kyoto kappo · Sanjo] A worn, quiet counter kappo down an alley off Kawaramachi-Sanjo, open since 1942 and among the first of its kind, still cooking bento for Gion tea houses: classic Kyoto courses from about ¥8,000, bento by order. About ¥15,000–20,000 at dinner.

chef_bio.background: Established in 1942, one of the pioneering counter kappo of Kyoto, which has trained many chefs and caters to Gion tea houses (September 2011 review); a July 2025 diner had heard it used to cater for Pontocho tea houses. Tabelog names Masako Shirasu, Shotaro Ikenami and Junichiro Tanizaki among those who loved it.
chef_bio.specialty: Counter kappo; bento for tea houses.

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 group dinner found the soup, grilled and simmered dishes rooted in sound training, but wished for more than one sake, Kiku Masamune.
A diner with memories going back 38 years still receives summer and New Year greetings from the shop, and recommends the bento ordered ahead (April 2024).
A November 2022 diner in kimono ate the shop's bento at a Gion tea house, down to the momiji tofu and kuzumochi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 河しげ 三条本店、日本料理、中京区河原町通三条下る東入大黒町46、三条駅・京阪三条駅から徒歩3分、火〜日 11:30〜13:30・17:30〜21:00、月曜休み、チャージ料無し、15席、4人用の個室、仕出し弁当と配達、コースは8,000円から、Masako Shirasu・Shotaro Ikenami・Junichiro Tanizaki ゆかりの店 (紹介文、英訳)。口コミ (2008〜2025年、英語): 1942年創業、カウンター割烹の先駆け、祇園のお茶屋に仕出し、おまかせ15,000円から (2011年)、Akashi の鯛、鱧、トロ、aori いか、栗と銀杏、生麩の揚げ物、momiji 豆腐と葛餅の弁当 (2022年11月)、日本酒は2011年は Tamano Hikari、2025年7月は Kiku Masamune のみ。

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through July 2025.

kyoto_tonshabu_hide_shijo_karasuma.gf_detail: Ask. Shabu-shabu meat and vegetables, but ponzu, sesame and miso dipping sauces and the ramen to finish are wheat or soy-based (2014–2026 reviews).
kyoto_tonshabu_hide_shijo_karasuma.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork, beef and chicken shabu-shabu (2014–2026 reviews).
kyoto_tonshabu_hide_shijo_karasuma.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–14:00 (L.O. 13:30) and 17:00–22:00 (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). No cover charge (Tabelog Japanese original 「チャージ料なし」). Cards and e-money (Tabelog). 80 seats, tables and sunken kotatsu; non-smoking, smoking near the entrance (Tabelog; February 2021 review). 2nd floor, 1 min from exit 15 of Karasuma / Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_tonshabu_hide_shijo_karasuma.notes: [Pork shabu-shabu · Shijo-Karasuma] A big, homely second-floor shabu-shabu room a minute from Karasuma, popular with overseas visitors: pork, chicken or beef with free refills of vegetables, cheap set courses and lunch hot pots. About ¥3,000–8,000.

chef_bio.background: The Shijo-Karasuma main shop of three (with 京都離れ店 and 心斎橋店; own site). Homely service by older women on the staff (November 2023 and January 2026 reviews); English greetings and many overseas guests (November 2018 and December 2022 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A New Year 2026 diner found the room nearly full by 6 pm and liked the older women on the staff and the free refills.
An April 2026 couple splurged on the pork, beef and chicken all-you-can-eat course and managed only one extra plate of beef.
A November 2023 diner who booked at the last minute was surprised by the warm welcome.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 豚しゃぶ英 京都四条烏丸店、しゃぶしゃぶ・鍋・豚しゃぶ、下京区高材木町226 前田ビル2F、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅15番出口から徒歩1分、毎日 11:00〜14:00 (L.O. 13:30)・17:00〜22:00、予約可、チャージ料なし、カード・電子マネー可、80席、禁煙 (入口付近で喫煙可)。公式サイト: 京都四条烏丸本店、京都離れ店、心斎橋店。口コミ (2014〜2026年、英語): 豚しゃぶの特選コース2,480円 (2019年10月)、Awa の豚、豚・牛・鶏の食べ放題 (2026年4月)、一人鍋のランチ、ポン酢と味噌、締めのラーメン、年配の女性スタッフ、海外の客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff greet in English; many overseas guests (2018 and 2022 reviews).

existence.note: Tabelog listing and own site; reviews dated through April 2026.

kyoto_cafe_loto_sanjo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: madeleines, egg tarts, financiers, roll cake and tarts (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_cafe_loto_sanjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: butter and egg baked sweets, café latte (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_cafe_loto_sanjo.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–18:00; hours may change (Tabelog). A February 2025 review gives Wed–Fri 12:00–18:00 and Sat 12:00–20:00. Seats upstairs require ordering food; drinks alone at the counter or the bench outside; shoes off upstairs (2025–26 reviews). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). One table for six upstairs and a bench in front (2025–26 reviews). On Komonmae Street among antique shops and galleries, near Sanjo (Tabelog; January 2026 review).
kyoto_cafe_loto_sanjo.notes: [Café · Komonmae Street] A tiny coffee stand in a renovated townhouse among the antique shops of Komonmae Street, by a cookery researcher: espresso drinks and fresh madeleines, egg tarts and seasonal cakes, with one shared table upstairs (shoes off) or a bench outside. About ¥1,000–2,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 23 February 2023; a café of the cookery researcher Masayo Takeda (February 2025 review), who also heads a culinary research institute (January 2026 review). Designed by the architect Yasushi Horibe, which draws architecture fans (February 2026 review). Latte-art events (August 2025 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Madeleines and egg tarts with coffee.

anecdotes.text: After a Mika Ninagawa exhibition at the Kyoto City KYOCERA Museum of Art (March 2025), a visitor had a madeleine and café latte on the bench outside.
A March 2025 visitor who rarely eats egg tarts was won over by a burst of vanilla.
A January 2026 visitor arrived just as the madeleines came out of the oven and took more away.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Cafe Loto kyoto、カフェ、東山区元町367、三条駅から235m、毎日 10:00〜18:00 (変更の可能性あり)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 2023年2月23日オープン、料理研究家 Masayo Takeda のカフェ、建築家 Yasushi Horibe の設計、Komonmae Street、町家を改装、2階は靴を脱いで6人掛けのテーブル1つ、2階の利用は食べ物の注文が必要、カフェラテ700円、エスプレッソ500円、エッグタルト400円、マドレーヌ300円、ホットコーヒー600円、キャラメルのロールケーキ600円、マンゴーのタルト、営業は水曜〜金曜 12:00〜18:00・土曜 12:00〜20:00 という口コミも (2025年2月)。

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through July 2026.

kyoto_the_door_takakura.gf_detail: Ask. A bar with a full food menu — carbonara, katsu sandwich, omurice — mostly wheat; cheese and nuts may suit (2018–2026 reviews).
kyoto_the_door_takakura.vegan_detail: Ask. Drinks and mixed nuts; most food is meat, egg or cheese (2018–2026 reviews).
kyoto_the_door_takakura.hours_raw: Daily 18:00–02:00; irregular closures (Tabelog); last order 2 am (May 2026 review). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Cover charge ¥600 (Tabelog Japanese original 「チャージ600円」). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money (Tabelog). 31 seats: 9 at the counter, 22 at tables, private rooms upstairs; smoking allowed (Tabelog; May 2025 review). In a remodelled townhouse on Takakura just south of Shijo, by Daimaru (Tabelog).
kyoto_the_door_takakura.notes: [Machiya bar · Shijo-Takakura] A bar in a remodelled townhouse by Daimaru, with a counter and small garden downstairs and private rooms upstairs: single-malt highballs, cocktails and a surprisingly full food menu until 2 am. Smoking allowed. About ¥3,000–6,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 23 September 2010 (Tabelog). A remodelled townhouse; the small garden behind the counter was designed by Katsuaki Ogawa, son of the 11th-generation Ogawa Jihei (Tabelog). A sister bar, The door Horikawa, is in the Tabelog crawl.

anecdotes.text: On a May 2025 bar crawl, turned away from a famous bar next door, a visitor let the bartender choose single-malt highballs and talked Hanshin baseball with the next customer.
A May 2026 visitor came after the last train for carbonara and a ¥1,600 kiwi cooler — about ¥6,000 for two.
On the first night of an October 2025 weekend in Kyoto, a visitor made it a fourth stop for a martini and a Royal Lochnagar twice up.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ザ・ドアー 高倉店、バー・ワインバー、下京区高倉通四条下ル高材木町224、四条烏丸駅から徒歩5分 (Daimaru 前の Louis Vuitton の横の通り)、毎日 18:00〜翌2:00、不定休、予約可、チャージ600円、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners) 可、電子マネー不可、31席 (カウンター9、テーブル22)、個室、喫煙可、2010年9月23日オープン、町家を改装したバー、1階カウンター奥の坪庭は十一代 Ogawa Jihei の息子 Katsuaki Ogawa の作 (英訳)。口コミ (2018〜2026年、英語): シングルモルトのハイボール、スモークチーズとミックスナッツ、マティーニ、カルボナーラ、キウイのクーラー1,600円、カツサンド、デミグラスのオムライス、2階の個室。

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through May 2026. The bar-door.com site did not resolve on 2026-11-07.
